answer_text: DTLS tunnels can use UDP port 1337 as an alternate DTLS port. This is recommended in locations with restrictive networks or connectivity issues (for example, China) where DTLS over UDP port 443 can experience packet loss; by default, DTLS uses port 443 and will fall back to 1337 when issues occur. To enable it, go to System Settings (Resources > System Settings) and turn on the Alternative DTLS Port option (note that enabling may cause DTLS tunnels to reconnect briefly). The knowledge base does not specify any version prerequisites for using the alternate UDP port.
